description: JB_Type elements make only sense in conjunction with JAT_Type
elements.  One element of each type is necessary to hold all
data for the execution of one job. One JB_Type element an
x JAT_Type elements are needed to execute an array job with
x tasks.
The relation between these two elements is defined in the
'JB_ja_tasks' sublist of a 'JB_Type' element. This list will
contain all belonging JAT_Type elements.
The 'JAT_Type' CULL element containes all attributes in which
one array task may differ from another array task of the
same array job. The 'JB_Type' element defines all attributes
wich are equivalent for all tasks of an array job.
A job and an array job with one task are equivalent
concerning their data structures. Both consist of one 'JB_Type'
and one 'JAT_Type' element

attributes.name: job_number
description: holds values in the range of 1..std::numeric_limits<uint32_t>::max()

attributes.name: job_name
description: (qsub/qalter -N job_name)

attributes.name: version
description: will be in increased when job is modified

attributes.name: jid_request_list
description: Dependencies as requested via qsub -hold_jid.
Can be job ids or job names, including the use of wildcards. (JRE_Type only JRE_job_name)

attributes.name: jid_predecessor_list
description: list of job numbers of predecessor jobs (JRE_Type only JRE_job_name)

attributes.name: jid_successor_list
description: list of job numbers of successor jobs (JRE_Type only JRE_job_name)

attributes.name: ja_ad_request_list
description: Job dependencies between jobs and their array tasks
requested via qsub -hold_jid_ad
e.g. when task 1 of job a has finished then task 1 of job b can start
Can be job ids or job names, including the use of wildcards. (JRE_Type only JRE_job_name)

attributes.name: ja_ad_predecessor_list
description: List of job numbers of predecessor jobs for array job dependencies (JRE_Type only JRE_job_name)

attributes.name: ja_ad_successor_list
description: List of job numbers of successor jobs for array job dependencies (JRE_Type only JRE_job_name)

attributes.name: session
description: Jobs session (JAPI session tag for job event selection)

attributes.name: project
description: Project name (qsub -P project_name)

attributes.name: department
description: Department name. Set by schedd, saved (once) to qmaster.

attributes.name: directive_prefix
description: Command prefix for jobscript ("qsub -C prefix") for parsing
special comments in the script file.

attributes.name: exec_file
description: is the path to the locally spooled copy on the execution daemon,
it is script that actually gets executed,
In the case of a binary, is unused.

attributes.name: script_file
description: is the path to the job as sent from the CLI, is the path on the submit host
In the case of a binary, is the path to the binary

attributes.name: script_size
description: @todo really needed?

attributes.name: script_ptr
description: the pointer to the character area of the jobscript

attributes.name: submission_time
description: timestamp in microseconds since epoch

attributes.name: execution_time
description: When should the job start ("qsub/qalter -a date_time")
timestamp in microseconds since epoch

attributes.name: deadline
description: SGEEE. Deadline initiation time. (qsub -dl date_time)
timestamp in microseconds since epoch

attributes.name: owner
description: user who submitted the job
@todo rename to JB_user to be consistent?

attributes.name: uid
description: user id of the job owner

attributes.name: group
description: primary group name of the job owner

attributes.name: gid
description: primary group id if the job owner

attributes.name: account
description: Account string ("qsub/qalter -A account string")

attributes.name: cwd
description: Current working directory from qsub ("qsub -cwd" or "qsub -wd")

attributes.name: notify
description: Notify job of impending kill/stop signal. ("qsub -notify")

attributes.name: type
description: Start job immediately or not at all. ("qsub -now")
@todo it could be a boolean, but is misused for other information!

attributes.name: reserve
description: Specifies if a reservation is desired by the user ("qsub -R y|n").
Available for non-immediate job submissions. Irrespective
of the users desire a job reservation is made
o only in reservation scheduling mode
o only until the maximum number of reservations during a
scheduling run is not exceeded when the order comes at
this job. The maximum number (SC_max_reservation) can be
specified in sched_conf(5).
o only for non-immediate jobs
Default is 'n'.

attributes.name: priority
description: Priority ("qsub/qalter -p priority")

attributes.name: jobshare
description: Priority ("qsub/qalter -js jobshare")

attributes.name: shell_list
description: Command interpreter to be used (PN_Type).
("qsub/qalter -S shell")

attributes.name: verify
description: Triggers "verify" messages. (qsub -verify)

attributes.name: env_list
description: Export these env variables (VA_Type). ("qsub -V").

attributes.name: context
description: Custom attributes (name,val) pairs (VA_Type).
The result of the -ac, -sc and -dc switches, see JB_context_change.

attributes.name: job_args
description: Job arguments (ST_Type).

attributes.name: checkpoint_attr
description: Checkpoint attributes ("qsub/qalter -c interval_flags")
@todo  merge all checkpointing stuff to one object?

attributes.name: checkpoint_name
description: Name of ckpt object ("qsub/qalter -ckpt ckpt_name")

attributes.name: checkpoint_object
description: Ckpt object which will be sent from qmaster to execd.
@todo: meaning when we change it in qmaster it will not be updated in execd

attributes.name: checkpoint_interval
description: Checkpoint frequency ("qsub/qalter -c seconds")

attributes.name: restart
description: Is job rerunable? ("qsub/qalter -r y/n")
@todo it could be a boolean but is misused for other information!

attributes.name: stdout_path_list
description: Pathname for stdout (PN_Type). ("qsub/qalter -o path_name")

attributes.name: stderr_path_list
description: Std error path streams (PN_Type). ("qsub/qalter -e path_name")

attributes.name: stdin_path_list
description: Std input path streams (PN_Type). ("qsub/qalter -i path_name")

attributes.name: merge_stderr
description: Merge stdout and stderr? ("qsub/qalter -j y|n")

attributes.name: request_set_list
description: List of request sets. 0 .. 3 request sets can exist: global, master, slave.
Sequential jobs can have a single job request set, the global one.
Parallel jobs can have up to 3 request sets: global requests,
requests for the master task, requests for the slave tasks.

attributes.name: mail_options
description: (qsub/qalter -m mail_options)

attributes.name: mail_list
description: Mail recipiants (MR_Type).
(qsub/qalter -M mail_list)

attributes.name: pe
description: Name of requested PE or wildcard expression for matching PEs
(qsub/qalter -pe pe-name slot_range)

attributes.name: pe_range
attributes.summary: Requested Slot Range for Parallel Environment
description: PE slot range (RN_Type). Qmaster will ensure that it is ascending and normalized
(qsub/qalter -pe pe-name slot_range)

attributes.name: tgt
description: Kerberos client TGT

attributes.name: cred
description: DCE/Kerberos credentials. Also used for TLS encryption to transport the credentials
from qrsh to the sge_execd, which will store it in the job's active_jobs directory.

attributes.name: ja_structure
description: Elements describe task id range structure during the
submission time of a (array) job (RN_Type).
qsub -t tid_range

attributes.name: ja_n_h_ids
description: Just submitted array task without hold state (RN_Type).

attributes.name: ja_u_h_ids
attributes.summary: Array Task IDs with User Hold
description: Just submitted and user hold applied (RN_Type).
qsub -h -t tid_range
qalter -h u/U jid.tid1-tid2:step

attributes.name: ja_s_h_ids
attributes.summary: Array Task IDs with System Hold
description: Just submitted and system hold applied (RN_Type).
qalter -h s/S jid.tid1-tid2:step

attributes.name: ja_o_h_ids
attributes.summary: Array Task IDs with Operator Hold
description: Just submitted and operator hold applied (RN_Type).
qalter -h o/O jid.tid1-tid2:step

attributes.name: ja_a_h_ids
attributes.summary: Array Task IDs with Array Hold
description: Just submitted and array hold applied (RN_Type).
qalter -hold_jid_ad wc_job_list

attributes.name: ja_template
description: Template for new tasks. In SGEEE systems the schedd will
store initial tickets in this element. (JAT_Type)

attributes.name: ja_tasks
description: List of array tasks (in case of array jobs) or one task
(in case of a job) (JAT_Type).

attributes.name: host
attributes.summary: Host the job (array task) is executing on
description: SGEEE - host job is executing on. Local to schedd.
Not spooled.
@todo still used?

attributes.name: category
description: Category string reference used in schedd.

attributes.name: user_list
description: List of usernames (qsub/qalter -u username_list).
qsub -u does not exist. Not part of a job, but only
userd for qalter request as where condition. Could most
probably be passed via lCondition.
@todo change qalter, remove this attribute from job

attributes.name: job_identifier_list
description: condition for qalter? @todo Then it should better be passed
via condition. (ID_Type)

attributes.name: verify_suitable_queues
description: @todo used in qalter?

attributes.name: soft_wallclock_gmt
description: Timestamp (microseconds since epoch) when a soft wallclock limit will take effect

attributes.name: hard_wallclock_gmt
description: Timestamp (microseconds since epoch) when a hard wallclock limit will take effect

attributes.name: override_tickets
description: SGEEE - override tickets assigned by admin.
(qalter -ot tickets).

attributes.name: path_aliases
description: Path aliases list (PA_Type).

attributes.name: urg
description: SGEEE. Absolute static urgency importance. The admin can use arbitrary
weighting factors in the formula used to determine this number. So any
value is possible. Needed only when scheduling code is run.
Not spooled.

attributes.name: nurg
description: SGEEE. Relative importance due to static urgency in the range between 0.0
and 1.0. No need to make this a per task attribute as long as waiting time
and deadline remain job attributes.
Not spooled.

attributes.name: nppri
description: SGEEE. Relative importance due to Posix priority in the range between 0.0
and 1.0. No need to make this a per task attribute as long as the POSIX
priority remains a job attribute.
Not spooled.

attributes.name: rrcontr
description: SGEEE. Combined contribution to static urgency from all resources. This can
be any value. Actually this is a property of job category. This field is
needed only to provide it for diagnosis purposes it as per job information
via GDI.
Not spooled.

attributes.name: dlcontr
description: SGEEE. Contribution to static urgency from waiting time. This can be any
value. No need to make this a per task attribute as long as waiting time
is a job attribute. Increases over time.
Not spooled.

attributes.name: wtcontr
description: SGEEE. Contribution to static urgency from waiting time. This can be any
value. No need to make this a per task attribute as long as waiting time
is a job attribute. Increases over time.
Not spooled.

attributes.name: ar
description: Unique advance reservation number.

attributes.name: pty
description: Interactive job should be started in a pty. 0=no, 1=yes, 2=use default.

attributes.name: ja_task_concurrency
description: The number of concurrent array tasks executing at any given time.

attributes.name: binding
description: Binding strategy for the job

attributes.name: submission_command_line
description: The submission command line as a string.
Arguments which contain whitespace or wildcards are enclosed in single quotes,
so it should be possible to copy/paste the command line into a shell.

attributes.name: grp_list
description: list of supplementary groups and corresponding ID's

attributes.name: joker
description: Placeholder which can be used for arbitrary data.
Its purpose is to be able to add new attributes without changing the spooling format.
It is a list of arbitrary type and it is spooled.

attributes.name: sync_options
description: Bits that have been specified to the -sync switch.

attributes.name: category_id
description: Category ID (CAT_id). Within the scheduler the field category refers to the category object.

attributes.name: when
description: Value of the -when qalter switch (enum qalter_when_t).

attributes.name: context_change
description: Instructions of the -ac, -sc and -dc switches (CX_Type), in the order given.
Sent by submit and qalter, applied to JB_context by the qmaster and not spooled.
